_comment: Spec for scripts/deb-copyright.py, which packaging/build-deb.sh runs to write
/usr/share/doc/monkeyspaw/copyright. Paths are relative to this file;
$SWIFT_LICENSE is the toolchain's share/swift/LICENSE.txt, located by the build.
